rule: Every cell below is fixed EX ANTE. A robustness cell can only characterise the primary result; it can NEVER replace the primary cell, cannot be promoted, and cannot be used to re-open the primary after a failure. Any cell that looks profitable while the primary fails is POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY.

analyses.definition: the primary trade set split into chronological halves and quartiles (same split semantics as G8), reported per split
the primary trade set reported separately for ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT (same per-follower semantics as G9)

the primary trade set attributed to UTC calendar quarters and to trend/volatility terciles computed from the leader's own trailing 288-bar realised volatility. The regime label is a POST-HOC attribution of the primary trades, never a signal filter.
mean net trade return at 0/10/20/40 bps on the IDENTICAL primary trade set (a superset of G11's two points)
the SAME rule re-evaluated with trailing scale lookbacks {144, 288, 576, 864} bars, reported as a neighbourhood around the frozen 288
the SAME rule re-evaluated with |z| thresholds {2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0}, reported as a neighbourhood around the frozen 3.0
the SAME rule re-evaluated with underreaction ratios {0.33, 0.50, 0.67, 0.80}, reported as a neighbourhood around the frozen 0.50
the SAME rule re-evaluated with holding periods {1, 3, 6, 12} bars (5/15/30/60 minutes), reported as a neighbourhood around the frozen 1
the primary trade set restricted to ETHUSDT only and to SOLUSDT only, reported as two single-follower views

an expanding-window walk-forward over chronological folds of the SAME frozen parameters (no refitting of any parameter, no refitting surface of any kind), reporting out-of-sample mean net return per fold
the concentration shares of G10 reported per quarter and per follower, plus the largest contributing trade list

kill_rule_interaction: a robustness cell that is negative does NOT by itself kill ARC-02 (only a critical primary gate failure does), but a robustness cell can never rescue a failed primary either. A future variant requires a NEW_HYPOTHESIS_ID and a NEW_PREREGISTRATION.
